content.text: Digital creators in regions with restricted access to platforms like Stripe and PayPal face significant challenges in [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/setting-up-nowpayments-webhooks-cloudflare-workers-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-about-selling-beats-online-crypto-payments-guide-5|COREMERCH guide to everything]]-you-13|setting]] up online stores. COREMERCH offers a solution that eliminates these barriers, enabling you to deploy a fully functional digital store using Cloudflare Pages without relying on traditional payment systems. This guide outlines a step-by-step process to set up your digital store, ensuring you can accept [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-what-actually-how-8|Crypto Payment]] payments seamlessly and efficiently.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment platforms often exclude creators in various countries, leaving them without the capability to monetize their skills. COREMERCH's infrastructure is designed to empower digital creators by leveraging decentralized technologies that operate independently of conventional payment systems. By utilizing Cloudflare Pages, you gain access to a robust hosting solution that is free and reliable while integrating with NOWPayments for immediate crypto payment processing. This approach ensures that you have complete control over your store and revenue, putting the power back into your hands.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your digital store, gather the necessary tools and resources. You will need a Cloudflare account, a GitHub account for repository management, and a NOWPayments account to facilitate cryptocurrency transactions. Familiarize yourself with the Sovereign Blueprint, which provides detailed documentation on how to structure your store. Ensure you have your digital products ready for upload, as you will configure them during the setup. By preparing these elements ahead of time, you streamline the deployment process and can launch your store efficiently.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by configuring your payment pipeline using NOWPayments. Create a new payment link in your NOWPayments dashboard and integrate it with your Cloudflare Pages store. Next, utilize Google Apps Script to handle backend logic for order management; this allows you to automate order confirmations and product delivery. Link your stored products on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to ensure seamless access for your customers. This setup guarantees that once a payment is confirmed, your digital products are delivered instantly, enhancing customer satisfaction.
Empower your digital business with full ownership of your infrastructure.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

With your store setup complete, it's time to go live. Publish your Cloudflare Pages site and ensure all links are functional. Test the payment system with a small transaction to confirm that everything operates smoothly. Monitor the process on the NOWPayments dashboard to verify that your payment is processed without issues. Once you've confirmed that the transaction works as intended, promote your store to your audience. Utilize social media channels and your network to drive traffic to your site, generating your first sales quickly.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully launching your digital store, consider strategies for scaling your operations. Start by analyzing traffic and sales data to understand customer behavior. You can expand your product offerings by utilizing the Edge Commerce Stack from COREMERCH, which allows you to add more products and configure advanced features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC for better email deliverability. Engage with your customers for feedback, and continually optimize your store based on their input. This proactive approach will ensure your business can grow sustainably in a competitive digital landscape.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The setup sequence matters because each component depends on the previous one being correctly configured. Start with NOWPayments: create your account, configure wallet addresses for each coin you want to accept, generate the API key, and note the IPN secret key you will set. Then configure the backend: in Stack 01, deploy the Google Apps Script Web App and note its URL; in Stack 02, deploy the Cloudflare Worker and note its URL. Set that URL as the webhook endpoint in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Then configure the storefront. Then run a real mainnet test — send actual crypto to your configured wallet address, confirm NOWPayments detects it, confirm the webhook fires, and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link.
No monthly fees or subscriptions; you own everything after deployment.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Creators at the store setup stage comparing Stack 01 and Stack 02 are typically choosing between building it themselves with the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 — which covers both stacks in complete detail with full source code — or having COREMERCH deploy the complete Edge Stack under their accounts with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Both result in the same ownership structure: your GitHub or Cloudflare account, your Supabase database, your NOWPayments account, your wallet, your store. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Create a Cloudflare account to host your site and a GitHub account for repository management. Set up a NOWPayments account to handle cryptocurrency transactions. Prepare your digital products for upload and read the Sovereign Blueprint for deployment guidance. Configure payment and delivery pipelines with Google Apps Script and link your products for seamless delivery. Publish your site on Cloudflare Pages and test your payment system before promoting your store.

Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages are excellent options for hosting a digital product store, offering cost-effective solutions that are perfect for creators looking to monetize their digital products.
What payment options can I use for my digital store?
You can use NOWPayments to handle over 300 cryptocurrencies, providing a seamless payment experience without the need for buyer accounts or KYC processes.
How long does it take to set up my digital store?
Setup time can vary; Stack 01 can be deployed in 4-6 hours, while Stack 02 takes 48 hours. Both options ensure your store is fully operational and tested before launch.
